c4BelowEner.label: Constellation 4 at low Energy
c4BelowEner.reason: Adds Energy Recharge only, to the character connected to the Jinni, which none of her counted hits use.

c6AfterSkill.label: Constellation 6 after her Skill
c6AfterSkill.reason: A Constellation 6 window of 3 seconds after her Skill that gives her Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks an Electro infusion; it covers only part of her Normal and Charged Attacks. It is counted when it is switched on here, which agrees with Genshin Optimizer when checked with it on.
